visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male creator with dark hair and a white-and-brown striped sweater stands in a brightly lit indoor room, holding three packaged snacks from a convenience store. He smiles directly at the camera. (2) A close-up shows a rectangular dark brown tofu dessert bar being removed from its packaging; it has a dense, cake-like texture. The creator takes a bite and reacts with a pleasant facial expression. (3) The focus shifts to a salted rice ball in a white plastic wrapper; the creator unwraps it to reveal plain white rice and takes a large bite, looking satisfied. (4) An animated graphic of a female office worker at a desk appears briefly over the creator, followed by a slow-motion shot of two people's hands interlacing against a bright, overcast sky background. (5) A screen recording of a mobile application interface appears, showing various video thumbnails, a shopping cart icon, and red buttons for a 'Partner Program' with a red arrow clicking through different screens. (6) The creator holds a long chicken and chili sandwich in clear plastic packaging, then takes a bite, closing his eyes to emphasize the flavor while looking at the lens.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator throughout; 2 hands visible in a brief interlace shot; 1 animated female character graphic.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with short black hair, wearing a high-collared sweater with thick horizontal white, beige, and dark brown stripes.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A simple indoor room with white walls, a colorful pop-art poster on the left, and a bright window. Later, a digital screen recording of a mobile app, and a brief shot of hands against a bright sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately with a rising pitch over an upbeat electronic pop BGM. The voice is crisp and enunciated. (2) A clear crinkling sound of a plastic bag rustling is layered under the voice, followed by three distinct, wet crunching sounds of biting into food. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition between the dessert and the rice ball segments. The BGM remains constant in tempo. (4) The speaker's tone shifts to a slightly more philosophical pitch; a digital 'pop' sound effect occurs as an graphic is introduced. (5) Multiple digital 'ding' and UI selection sounds trigger rapidly as the Shopee interface is discussed, synchronized with screen movements. (6) A final 'ding' effect occurs as the number one snack is revealed, with the narrator's volume increasing to a peak of high-arousal excitement.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Item 3 -> Item 2 -> Promotional Interlude -> Item 1 -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share 'niche' food recommendations from Japanese 7-Eleven stores to travelers while strategically pivoting in the middle to promote the Shopee Affiliate program (Shopee Short Video). It uses high-energy delivery and mouth-watering close-ups to build trust before showing how viewers can earn commission by sharing similar content.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the 'Shopee Short Video' program, showing the app interface, explaining the 15% commission rate, and providing a referral code 'GZBRK4E'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines a high-interest travel hook (Japan convenience store food) with a technical walkthrough of a mobile app's monetization feature. The use of ASMR-style chewing sounds enhances the sensory appeal of the food segments.
